Appraiser remarks
The front bumper cover is cracked across the center, the grille support has bent, and the hood latch and both
headlamp assemblies show impact marks consistent with a frontal strike at low speed. Damage pattern lines up well
with the account of the collision, and nothing in the file points to prior damage on this vehicle. The repair plan calls for
replacing the bumper cover and headlamps, straightening the radiator support, and refinishing the hood and bumper
area. Labor hours on the shop's estimate run slightly above what I would expect for this scope, so I have asked the
shop to review the time allowances. The invoices submitted show no repeated charges.
